# AeroPine

> AeroPine (aeropine.com) is a free web app that identifies the aircraft flying over your location right now, using live ADS-B data, and shows its airline, aircraft type, route, altitude, speed and a photo. It also publishes plain-English guides to reading flight-tracking data. It is for interest and education only, not for navigation.

## Tool

- [Live radar (home)](https://www.aeropine.com/): the closest aircraft to you, embedded in an explainer
- [Full-screen radar](https://www.aeropine.com/radar/)
